records.title: Does RoPE Prevent or Degrade Retrieval Heads? A Mechanistic Analysis Across Model Families
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Retrieval heads, attention heads that copy information from earlier context to the current position, have been proposed as the mechanistic substrate for long-context recall.
